spans.s:
शद् only I. शाशदु॑स् etc., pp. शा॑शदान distinguish
one's self, prevail.

†शद् perf. शशाद, pp. शन्न fall, decay. — व्यव fall
off or asunder. परि fall by the side.

शद m. fall (—˚);
 produce (of land).

शा॑द m. falling, dropping (—˚);
 grass. f. शादा brick.
स॑दा adv. always, ever, w. neg. never.
शद्वला f. N. of a river.

शाद्वल a. grassy, verdant, green;
 n. a grassy spot.
शादन n. falling out.
1 स॑दान a. having gifts.
2 सदान a. ruttish (elephant).
शाद्वलवन्त् a. = prec. a.
शाद्व˚लिन् a. = prec. a.
स॑दक्ष a. endowed with reason.
सदक्षिण a. along with presents.
सददि॑ adv. commonly, usually.
सदधन् a. (mixed) with sour milk.*
सदनास॑द् a. sitting down on the seat.
स॑दम् adv. always, ever.

सदय a. merciful, soft, tender, gentle;
 ˚— & n. adv.

सदर्प a. haughty, defying;
 n. adv.
1 सदश्व m. a good horse.

स॑दस् n. seat, place, dwelling, abode;
 meeting, assembly.
सदसत्फल (˚—) good and evil results.

सदसदात्मक f. ˚त्मिका whose-nature is at once to
be and not to be.

सदसद्भाव m. reality and unreality, truth and
falsehood.

स॑दसस्प॑ति m. lord of the seat i.e. of the
assembly (met for a sacred purpose).

स॑दस्प॑ति m. lord of the seat i.e. of the assembly
(met for a sacred purpose).

सदस्य॑ m. partaker of an assembly, esp. of a
Sattra-sacrifice.
1 सदागति f. constancy.
1 सदाचार m. good conduct or observance.
2 सदाचार a. well-conducted, virtuous.
सदाचारवन्त् a. = prec. 2.
सदाचा˚रिन् a. = prec. 2.
सदानन a. fair-faced.
1 सदानन्द m. eternal joy.
2 सदानन्द a. feeling or granting eternal joy.
सदानीरा॑ f. N. of a river.
सदा॑न्वा f. N. of cert. female demons.
सदापृण॑ a. always munificent.
सदाफल a. always bearing fruit.
स॑दाम a. along with the band or string.
सदामत्त a. always wanton or ruttish.
सदामद a. always wanton or ruttish.

सदार a. having a wife, married;
 together with a wife.
सदा॑वृध a. always delighting.
सदाशिव a. always kind or friendly.
सदास॑ह् a. everlasting.

सदासा॑ a. always winning or always^1 abounding.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
सदासुख n. eternal bliss.
सदि॑वस् adv. instantly, at once.
सदीनम् adv. miserably, lamentably.
सदुःख a. sad, unhappy.
सदूर्व a. covered with Dūrvā-grass.
सदृशक्षम a. of equal patience.

सदृशविनिमय m. confounding or exchanging equal
things.

सदृष्टिक्षेपम् adv. with an ogling (lit.
eye-throw).

सदृष्टि˚विक्षेपम् adv. with an ogling (lit.
eye-throw).
स॑देव a. accompanied or protected by the gods.
सदेवमनुष्य a. along with gods and men.

सदोगृह n. assembly-room;
 नृपस्य court of a prince.
सदोद्यम a. ever-zealous.
1 सदोष a. along with the night.
2 सदोष a. faulty, vicious, wrong.
सद्गति f. good condition or the path of the good.
1 सद्गुण m. good quality, virtue.
2 सद्गुण a. having good qualities, virtuous.
सद्गुरु m. a good teacher.
सद्धर्म m. the good law.

सद्धर्मपुण्डरीक n. the lotus of the good
law, T. of a work.
सद्भूत a. (being) true.
साद्भुत a. surprised, wondering.
सद्भृत्य m. a good servant.
1 सद्म॑न् m. sitter, dweller.
सद्य॑ऊति a. helping quickly or daily.
सद्यःकृत्त a. just cut.
सद्यःक्री॑ a. bought on the same day (Soma).
सद्यःपातिन् a. quickly dropping, frail.

सद्यःप्रसूता f. having just brought forth (a child
etc.).
सद्यःफल a. quickly bearing fruits or consequences.
सद्यःशौच n. present or immediate purification ((r.)).

सद्य॑स् adv. on the same day, in one day, daily;
immediately, recently, directly, at once, suddenly, quickly.
सद्यःसुत्या f. Soma-pressing on the same day.

सद्यो॑अर्थ a. quickly^1 reaching the goal.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
सद्योजू॑ a. quickly impelled.
सद्योभव a. having just begun, quite fresh.
सद्योमांस n. fresh meat.
सद्योमृत a. just died.
सद्रत्न n. a true jewel or pearl.
सद्रव्य a. along with the money.
1 सद्वंश m. a god stem or (and) family.
2 सद्वंश a. sprung from a good family.
सद्वचस् n. a fine speech.
सद्वत्सल a. kind to the good.
†सद्वन् a. sitting.
सद्वार्त्ता f. good news.

सद्विगर्हित^1 a. blamed by the good or wise.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: the 'M' in print may be smudge or accent.
सद्विद्य a. having true knowledge.
सद्विद्या f. true knowledge or learning.
सद्वृक्ष m. a good tree.
1 सद्वृत्त n. a fine roundness or good conduct.
2 सद्वृत्त a. well-conducted.
सद्वृत्ति f. & n. good conduct, virtue.
सद्वैद्य m. a good physician.
सादन्य॑ a. domestic.
सादयितव्य a. to be destroyed.
सादि m. rider (lit. sitter).
सादि॑न् m. rider (lit. sitter).
सादृश्य n. likeness, similarity.

साद्य a. fit for riding;
 m. riding-horse.
